Vanilla bean prices increased to a record $600 a kilogramme in 2018 after a cyclone hit the tropical island of Madagascar, damaging crops. Madagascar supplies 75% to 80% of the world vanilla bean market. Annotate the diagram below to show the effect of the cyclone on the price of vanilla beans.
With reference to Extract A, explain the likely reasons for the change in price of electronic devices. Include a supply and demand diagram in your answer.
In 2021, energy regulator Ofgem announced that the maximum price of energy will rise from £ 1 277 to £ 1 971 a year, for the average household bill. Define the term ‘equilibrium price’.
Discuss likely reasons why the market price of streaming television content is increasing. Draw a supply and demand diagram to support your answer.

Disney+ is a streaming service that distributes films and television series produced by the Walt Disney Studios. Draw a supply and demand diagram to show the likely effect of the change in the number of subscribers on the market equilibrium for Disney+ services.

The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) produces more than 60% of the world’s supply of cobalt, from its small-scale mines. Many new small mines opened in 2018 as a result of improved expectations of profit. The following graph shows the price of cobalt between June 2018 and June 2019. With reference to the information provided, draw a supply and demand diagram to show why the price of cobalt fell between June 2018 and June 2019.

The diagram below shows the demand for and supply of passenger rail services. The shift of the demand curve from D1 to D2 is most likely to result from a:
options: government decision to impose a tax on workplace parking

questions.questionText: With reference to Figure 1 and Extract A, discuss the benefits of allowing universities to charge higher tuition fees for some degree courses.

The International Energy Agency has predicted that oil use by cars will peak in 2025 because of the increasing number of drivers switching to electric vehicles. Evaluate the likely microeconomic consequences of consumers shifting from vehicles powered by fuel obtained from oil to electric‑powered vehicles.

In August 2017 Hurricane Harvey caused the closure of nearly a quarter of the oil production capacity in the United States. Draw a supply and demand diagram to show the likely microeconomic effects of the hurricane on the US oil market.
Discuss likely reasons why the prices of treatments in private sector hospitals are increasing. Draw a supply and demand diagram to support your answer.

The average fee charged by high-street estate agents to homeowners for selling property is 1.3% of the final sale price. In August 2016 the Office for National Statistics reported that the average house price in London was £489 000, whereas in the North East of England it was £127 000. Explain one likely reason for the difference in average house prices between London and the North East of England.
With reference to Figure 1, explain one likely reason for the overall trend in the real price of gas and electricity.
With reference to Figure 1 and Extract A, explain why the price of uranium has ‘fallen to a 13-year low’ (Extract A, lines 2 and 3) in 2016. Include a supply and demand diagram in your answer.
Discuss the likely microeconomic effects of this decision on energy producers and consumers. Include a supply and demand diagram in your answer.

The table shows market data for e-cigarette kits. The original equilibrium price is £23. As a result of a successful advertising campaign, demand increased by 3 000 e-cigarette kits at all prices. At the same time production costs fell leading to an increase in supply of 1 000 e-cigarette kits at all prices. Calculate the new equilibrium price and quantity following the successful advertising campaign and the fall in production costs. Use the last two columns for your working.

In 2015 the UK government cut subsidies for the installation of solar energy panels. Annotate the diagram below to show the effect of removing the solar panel installation subsidy on the equilibrium price and quantity.
The excess supply of carbon steel has recently caused its global price to fall below $530 per tonne. Explain how the price mechanism responds to excess supply in a free market.

Universities UK raised concerns about the proposal to reduce the maximum tuition fees (fee cap) for undergraduate courses in England from £9 000 to £6 000. It stated “This unfunded proposal to reduce the fee cap would damage the quality of experience our universities could deliver to students and remove opportunities for those seeking to benefit from a university education”. Explain why reducing the tuition fee cap may result in excess demand for university places.
With reference to Extract A, assess the likely impact of the Help to Buy scheme on the market for rented properties in the UK.
With reference to Figure 2, calculate the percentage change in house prices between the first quarter of 2009 and the first quarter of 2015. You are advised to show your working.
